race.comment: HEAT MAP (6) closed last campaign with back-to-back placings, the last of which was at Ballarat Synthetic five months ago. Expected to go well with the benefit of that campaign from the good draw. TRUANT (4) was in the firing line on the bend and finished second last time over 1118m at Geelong, beaten 1.75 lengths. Meeting a deeper field this time but he is good enough to play a major role. ON A JOURNEY (8) was far from disgraced at the only start back in March, beaten less than three lengths by a handy one, and has trialled well since. LONG ISLAND OYSTER (1) made debut at Sale and finished in the placings before going for another break. Will strip fitter for recent trials and can sneak into the finish again.
